youtube.title: Why Envelopes Are Scribbled Inside ✉️ #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
Many envelopes for bills, bank letters and cheques are printed inside with a repeating pattern called a security tint. The pattern scrambles the outline of the printed text, so the contents can't be read if someone holds the sealed envelope up to a bright light. The same idea is used in security envelopes worldwide.
